$comment: Campus parking lots and who may park in each, read by Claude 2026-11-02 from the Public Safety parking pages for Dan's review. Every fact cites the page and the exact words it says them in; a build checks each quote against that page's capture and leaves out any fact the page no longer says. 'near' names a map building (its map key) or a building group (its name) only where the quote names the place.
